images.explanation: Focal hyperintense Glioblastoma lesion (radius ~18px) observed in parenchyma with marked surrounding peritumoral vasogenic edema. Spatial contrast (0.042) and tissue heterogeneity are strongly elevated with significant loss of bilateral hemispheric symmetry (0.64). Classical SVM and Quantum QSVM classify as Pathological with 96.4% confidence.
